package: THT vertical wire-entry screw terminal block, 3 poles, 5.08 mm pitch (Cixi Kefa KF128-5.08 family, generic P=2-24 mechanical drawing)
description: KF128-5.08-3P-AA - 3-pole THT screw terminal block, KEFA KF128-5.08 series. Datasheet is the FAMILY drawing (same PDF content served for every pole count C474952..C4749xx, title block 'KF128-5.08', dated 21.03.13, rev A): only the pole count P and the derived span (P-1)x5.08 change between orders. Used on this board as J1: IN+/IN-/GND (3-pole body chosen so both signal poles share identical metallurgy/moulding - see architecture/blocks.md B1 and the workspace's in-terminal-selection / in-terminal-thermal-emf knowledge records). Produced by the librarian (P3) directly from the vendor mechanical drawing because no upstream datasheet-extraction JSON existed for this LCSC id - parts.json's own extraction only covered C34250 and C38732. Scope kept to the land_pattern + mechanical facts fp_verify needs, not a full electrical extraction (this is a passive mechanical part, no abs_max/decoupling applicable).

pinout.name: Pole 1
pinout.notes: Screw-clamp terminal, leftmost pole viewed from the front (pin markings/silk). Board usage (parts.json/sheets.md): J1 pin 1 = IN+. Generic 'Pole N' name used here because this datasheet describes the PART, not this board's net assignment.

pinout.name: Pole 2
pinout.notes: Centre pole. Board usage: J1 pin 2 = IN-. Same contact stack as pole 1 (same moulding, same copper-alloy/tin-plated contact lot) - the mechanism the thermal-EMF requirement on this board's input pair depends on.

pinout.name: Pole 3
pinout.notes: Rightmost pole. Board usage: J1 pin 3 = GND (bias-current return path for both inputs, and cable-shield landing point per blocks.md B1).

land_pattern.package: 3-pole THT vertical screw terminal, 5.08 mm pitch
land_pattern.notes: Vendor 'PCB LAYOUT' inset + 'Other Data' table (p.1, the only page): 'PCB板孔径 PCB Hole Diameter [mm]: 1.4', pitch '间距 Pitch [mm]: 5.08', with the layout inset's own diameter callout reading 'Φ1.40 +0.10/-0.00' next to the 3-hole pattern and '5.08±0.03' between adjacent holes - i.e. the recommended PCB drill for EVERY pole in the P=2-24 family is 1.4 mm, read directly off the drawing, not inferred. No separate copper-pad (land) diameter is vendor-stated - as with C34250.json's SOIC-8, the datasheet gives the mechanical hole only and leaves pad/annulus sizing to the board designer; pad_size_mm is deliberately left out of this land_pattern for that reason (see extraction schema note on C34250.json). Pin cross-section read off the elevation-view dimensions (not a labelled table entry, a drawing measurement): approximately 0.80 mm x 0.90 mm rectangular pin, 'Pin Dimensions [mm]: 4.3' (pin protrusion length below the mounting shoulder) in the Other Data table. cross-check: a 0.80x0.90 mm pin has a ~1.20 mm diagonal, so the vendor's own 1.4 mm hole gives ~0.10 mm clearance per side and this board's PULLED (easyeda2kicad) 3-pole footprint uses a 1.400 mm drill on a 2.4 mm pad (0.50 mm annulus) - an EXACT match to the vendor figure, comfortably above the fp_verify/JLC 0.15 mm annulus floor. NOTE for the orchestrator: the sibling 2-pole part C474952 (identical family, identical pin, same datasheet PDF) pulls at 1.6 mm drill instead of 1.4 mm - see this librarian's OPEN section, not corrected here without approval.

layout_notes: Screw torque max M2.5 / 0.4 N*m (Other Data table) - mechanical only, not a PCB layout constraint.

Wire range 22-12 AWG solid/stranded, strip length 6-7 mm (Other Data table); wider than the ~24-16 AWG this workspace's requirements assumed for the sensor cable (see parts.json J1 role note) - the clamp accepts thinner wire down to 22 AWG but is not sized around it.

Operating temperature -40 to +105 degC; rated voltage/current headroom (300 V / 10 A UL, or 250-630V/24A IEC tiers by contamination class) is far past this board's signal/mV-class use and is not the selection driver (see parts.json J1 role and the in-terminal-selection knowledge record).
